scope: Exact finite causal orders and a proposed mechanical identification experiment are separate comparison domains.

exact.input: C is the strict transitive causal matrix; C[i,j]=1 iff i precedes j. No reflexive diagonal. Relabelling is gauge; order reversal is not identified.
exact.spectrum: det(xI-O), all coefficients in descending order, arbitrary precision decimal integer strings, no rounding, unit 1
exact.endpoints: [number of minimal elements, number of maximal elements, number of isolated elements]
exact.directed_degrees: Lexicographically sorted multiset of (column sum, row sum) pairs of C, flattened. Degrees count all causal relations, not only Hasse links. Pairing and multiplicity retained.
exact.comparison: Exact equality of registered complete feature values under identical definitions and context. Hashes bind artifacts; hash inequality is not itself a physical discriminator.
exact.selection: Among admissible candidates, use maximum expected eliminated pairs divided by registered cost; deterministic feature-id tie break. If no predictive model exists use a fixed predeclared low-cost order, without claiming optimality.
exact.demo_selection: Fixed low-cost order: S; add A,K; add endpoints; add directed degree multiset. Demonstration on a preselected known pair, not an unbiased benchmark of adaptive policy.
exact.stop: Separated within registered corpus, no admissible observable, or budget exhausted. Separation does not prove general injectivity or physical equivalence.

physical_pilot.coordinate_frame: Fixture Cartesian metres; axes and force direction fixed before acquisition.
physical_pilot.excitation: Measured stationary broadband force in the registered linear regime; actuator settings and mounting documented separately.
physical_pilot.estimator: Demean; Welch Hann, 16384 samples, 50% overlap; one-sided spectra; S_xy = mean(conj(X)*Y); H1_i=S_Fai/S_FF; coherence=|S_Fai|^2/(S_FF*S_aiai). No automatic time alignment.
physical_pilot.quality: No clipped or missing samples; verified calibration, time skew and anti-alias response; input exceeds a preregistered measured noise-floor margin; confirmation records acquired independently. Coherence >=0.9 is a proposed bin-use gate, not proof of linearity or equivalence.
physical_pilot.comparison: Register feature distance, practical effect threshold and uncertainty method before confirmation. Only a simultaneous confidence interval for the between-object difference entirely outside the equivalence band supports separation; overlap or non-rejection means unresolved/inconclusive. Unknown uncertainty cannot confirm separation.
physical_pilot.adaptive_budget: At most 3 additional registered acquisition configurations per object; reserve an untouched confirmation set. Multiple-test error budget across tested observables must be specified before a physical decision.
